title: NFL to consider allowing replay officials to flag non-football acts unpenalized on the field

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL to consider allowing replay officials to flag non-football acts unpenalized on the field
sources.description: The NFL Competition Committee has discussed a change to the league's rules that would allow replay officials throw penalty flags for fouls that went unpunished on the field.
